description: Check drug-drug interactions among a set of drugs. Returns curated interactions with severity, description, and management guidance. Accepts drug names or DrugBank IDs (comma-separated). Example: drugbank_ddi({ drugs: "warfarin, acetaminophen", _apiKey: "your-key" }) or drugbank_ddi({ drugs: "DB00682,DB00316", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: DrugBank API key (commercial; trial keys at dev.drugbank.com).

drugs.description: Comma-separated list of drug names or DrugBank IDs to check against each other, e.g. "warfarin, aspirin" or "DB00682,DB00945".

name: drugbank_ddi
title: Drugbank Ddi
